import asyncio, os
from sqlalchemy import text
from apps.api.database import engine

async def main():
    email = os.environ["ADMIN_EMAIL"]
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        result = await conn.execute(
            text("UPDATE users SET role = 'admin' WHERE lower(email) = lower(:email)"),
            {"email": email},
        )
        if result.rowcount != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f"Updated {result.rowcount} rows. Have the user log in once, then retry.")
        row = (await conn.execute(
            text("SELECT id, email, role FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower(:email)"),
            {"email": email},
        )).mappings().one()
        print(f"{row['email']} => {row['role']} ({row['id']})")

asyncio.run(main())
